title: Caught exception when trying to load file of format [py] in ros2 launch: reading the real error, package not found, imports and missing return, measured
excerpt: The real cause is the first bullet under the message; InvalidFrontendLaunchFileError is noise. Twelve Python launch file mistakes run on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical with identical errors, plus which pre-checks catch them: py_compile found 2 of 8, a runpy check found 8 of 8.
